question: **Slido Q22: From Java statements to messages** Which message order correctly represents placeOrder(o)?
options: Both messages must execute in parallel.
No messages because both fields are private.
explanation: Each call in the method body becomes a message from OrderController, drawn top to bottom in the order the statements run: repo.save(o) first, then ui.showConfirmation(). Statements in one method run one after another, so there is nothing parallel. private only stops OTHER classes from reading the fields; the controller can still use its own fields to send messages. (Checked by running it: save runs before showConfirmation.)
